english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for the sweet course served after a meal.
Use this as the all-purpose word for the dessert course or dessert in general.
Use this when the confection is served as a dessert, such as a pastry, cake, or other sweet dish.
Use this for a dessert or the dessert course, especially on a menu.

examples.english: Let's order dessert after the meal too.
